upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact commit; later PEFT revisions do not inherit qualification automatically.

materialChanges: Detects 1-D or zero-sized LoRA A/B tensors that typically indicate ungathered DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 or FSDP shards at adapter export time.
Emits PeftWarning for inferred state dicts rather than silently deferring the malformed-artifact failure to downstream loaders.
Leaves explicitly supplied state dicts outside this heuristic because their provenance is unknown.
Excludes legitimate one-dimensional parameters such as DoRA magnitude vectors and AdaLoRA lora_E from the LoRA A/B shape check.
Upstream warning does not refuse the write, so SZL requires separate receipt-backed publication integrity evidence before any adapter can advance.

acceptance: Pin exact PEFT source 78bce7cb48f800a7ad0d352b68a46302e13e1687, torch, DeepSpeed or FSDP, safetensors, base-model revision and adapter configuration.
Reproduce valid gathered export and intentionally ungathered one-dimensional or zero-sized lora_A/lora_B tensors on synthetic or fixed public non-secret fixtures.
Prove PeftWarning behavior for inferred state dicts and prove the explicit-state-dict bypass boundary; never describe the upstream warning as refusing a write.
Verify legitimate one-dimensional DoRA magnitude vectors and AdaLoRA lora_E parameters are not false positives.

Evaluate an independent SZL pre-publication receipt check requiring serialized LoRA A/B tensors to be at least two-dimensional, non-empty, immutable-byte readable, exact-base bound and successfully reloadable before public publication can be considered.
Exercise malformed shard, explicit-state-dict, save-load, immutable readback, cancellation, failure and rollback cases.
Do not silently turn the upstream warning into a production policy; any fail-closed SZL publisher guard requires its own reviewed implementation and tests.
Keep training, adapter or model publication, model qualification, provider routing and automatic promotion false until separate normal controls pass.

deduplication.result: material post-training artifact-integrity boundary: malformed distributed LoRA exports can look structurally valid and fail only at downstream load time
